A New Beginning, in Flowers

A friend in Japan has reopened
her jewellery brand, @su_jewelry_objects.
From Singapore, I wanted to mark the moment.

So I asked my florist in Japan,
@fleuriste_gnossiennes.

Flowers do something rare.
They warm the one who sends them,
as much as the one who receives them.

Her work has a quiet sense of beauty —
soft colour, a little wildness, nothing overdone.
Whenever I send flowers,
it is always to her that I turn.
